description:
Make the server's change watcher recognise `.jit` files through `VirtualPath` instead of raw file names.

## Background

`crates/server/src/watcher.rs` decides which filesystem events refresh the web UI. Its relevance filter matches `"gate-runs"`, `"issues"`, `"index.json"` and `"gates.toml"` as string literals (`watcher.rs:105-121`), although `crates/jit/src/repository_state/path.rs` declares each of these as a `VirtualPath` constant (`GATE_RUNS`, `ISSUES`, `INDEX`, `GATES`). The watcher therefore restates the repository layout, and a renamed constant would silently stop refreshing.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: No string literal in `crates/server/src/watcher.rs`, its test module included, names a well-known `.jit` file or directory; each comes from a `VirtualPath` constant or constructor.
- [hard] REQ-02: The watcher refreshes on exactly the same set of paths as before: issue records, gate-run records, the index and the gate registry.

## Notes

`VirtualPath` exposes the relative path of each constant; compare event paths against those values rather than against copies of the names.
title: The server watcher recognises .jit files through VirtualPath
